methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: This study, conducted in an office building located in Morocco, presents a concrete methodology for optimizing energy consumption in buildings

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Energy audit (ISO 50002) and techno-economic analysis of a single tertiary/office building in Meknes, Morocco, proposing three energy-conservation measures (resizing subscribed power, installing an EMS, installing a PV plant) evaluated via cost/savings, CO2 and payback. No EnPI/EnB performance-measurement model is presented or characterised: energy is treated only as total metered consumption plus tariff/cost accounting, the baseline is measured current consumption, and energy is not normalised against relevant variables (no regression, functional form, or indicator such as SEC or kWh/m2).

paper_type.evidence_quote: A practical case study conducted in a tertiary building in Morocco

stage1.notes: Methodology 'complies with ISO 50001 and ISO 50002' (audit standard) with on-site measurement plus SketchUp/PVSYST simulation. Quantitative apparatus = electricity-tariff formulas, energy savings=before-after, CO2 factor, payback. Tertiary/office building, not a continuous process industry; level_3b not applicable.
